description: This source file defines the PaymentCryptographyDataClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Payment Cryptography Data Plane service in AWS. The class includes method annotations for various cryptography operations such as encrypting, decrypting, generating MACs, and verifying cryptograms, both synchronously and asynchronously.
